item.title: VisionQuest
item.description:
Platform: Disney+
First Air Date: 2026-10-13

With a bounty on his head, Vision must confront his nature and resist Ultron's influence to survive.

item.title: Carrie
item.description:
Platform: Prime Video
First Air Date: 2026-10-07

After her father's sudden, untimely death thrusts her into the unforgiving ecosystem of public high school, Carrie is forced to navigate a viral bullying scandal that tears through her community, the relentless pressure and casual cruelty of the social‑media age, and the awakening of mysterious telekinetic powers that rise alongside her adolescence.

item.title: Below
item.description:
Platform: Netflix
First Air Date: 2026-10-08

When a mysterious sea creature terrorizes a small Newfoundland town, a hard-bitten fisherman and his family fight to protect their close-knit community.

item.title: Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story
item.description:
Platform: Netflix
First Air Date: 2026-09-17

Trapped in a cruel Victorian-era household, Lizzie Borden kills her parents in a gory ax murder that shocks the nation.

item.title: Treasure Island
item.description:
Platform: MGM+
First Air Date: 2026-10-11

Young Jim Hawkins and his mother Bess come into possession of a legendary pirate’s treasure map and are drawn into a deadly voyage across the Atlantic, where Jim is forced to navigate mutiny, violence and betrayal, leaving him forever changed.
